description: This dataset shows lands with agricultural potential on slopes of 0 to 10 percent in Puerto Rico, which are considered well suited for mechanized agriculture. It corresponds to a layer produced in 2017 by the USDA Forest Service International Institute of Tropical Forestry and published in 2018 (Research Data Archive RDS-2018-0004; Gould et al. 2017). Slopes were derived from the USGS 10 m elevation data, and developed land, wetlands, protected areas, river buffers, reservoirs and cays were excluded. The source reports about 124,187 hectares in this class, roughly 14 percent of Puerto Rico.
agency: USDA Forest Service, International Institute of Tropical Forestry / USDA Caribbean Climate Hub (W.A. Gould, F.H. Wadsworth, M. Quiñones, S.J. Fain, N.L. Álvarez-Berríos). Published through the Forest Service Research Data Archive.
